text.description_html: Crystal, glass, and porcelain knobs are great for adding a romantic, old world style to your door. Many of these glass knobsets are available with ornate rosettes, but some have more modern designs to effortlessly fit in with transitional themes. We also offer porcelain door knobs in both black in white colors for an alluring vintage appearance.
